transformer.name: pgvector:embeddings
transformer.title: Pgvector (Embeddings)
transformer.description: Prepares the message to become an object writable by PgVector component

transformerIn.description: A LangChain4j TextSegment, or a String the converter of camel-langchain4j-embeddings turns into one, whose text and metadata go in the CamelPgVectorTextContent and CamelPgVectorMetadata headers; another body stores no text. The embedding comes from the CamelLangChain4jEmbeddingsVector header, which must be set
